title: Share hotuna, gajeriyar nazarin shari'a da rukunin yanar gizon kyauta
course_title: Ginin Fayil na Kan Layi: Nuna Mafi kyawun Ayyukanku da Cin nasara Abokan ciniki

say: Share hotuna, gajeriyar nazarin shari'a, da rukunin yanar gizo kyauta.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don module na biyu na Ginin Fayil na Kan layi.
Don aikin jiki, hoto shine aikin, har zuwa mai duba kan layi. Kyakkyawan kaya a cikin duhu, hoto mai duhu yana kama da matsakaicin kaya.
Ba kwa buƙatar ƙwararriyar kyamara. Wayar hannu, hasken rana taga da farar takarda sun isa.

say: Haske shine abu mafi mahimmanci. Sanya abu kusa da taga, tare da haske yana fitowa daga gefe. Hasken gefe yana nuna dinki, beading da icing.
Rike takardar farar takarda ko faranti a gefen duhu don tausasa inuwar. Ajiye bayanan a sarari.

panel.heading: Haske yana yin ko karya hoton
left: Haske mai laushi, babu rana kai tsaye

say: Ka guji tsantsar rana tsaka, wanda ke yin inuwa mai wuya. Kashe kwararan fitila na rufin rawaya, saboda haɗaɗɗen haske yana ba da launuka masu ban mamaki.
Kuma kada ku yi amfani da walƙiya. Yana ba da haske kuma yana sanya tabo masu haske akan sabulu, gilashi ko satin.

say: Don tunawa. Yi amfani da hasken rana mai laushi, babu walƙiya da bayyanannen bango. Ɗauki gabaɗaya, daki-daki, ma'auni da hotuna masu amfani.
Rubuta kowane nazari a matsayin matsala, tsari da sakamako, tare da sakamako na gaskiya kawai. Zaɓi babban gida ɗaya kyauta, duba an raba shi, sannan ka kiyaye kalmomin shiga.
